Cold Caller + Closer (Philippines, Remote)
description:
AT A GLANCE: US AI founder hiring ONE part-time closer to sell $20K setup + $1.5K/mo AI document search to US civil engineering firms (50-250 employees). Base $8.50/hr + 5?sh collected + 5% trailing MRR for 12 months + 13th-month bonus. On-target earnings: ~$2,400/mo by month 3, $4,000-$5,500/mo at 2 closes/mo full-time. 4 hrs/day, 10 PM-2 AM Manila, M-F. Weekends off.



I'm a US-based AI founder. I built a tool that solves a massive headache for civil engineering firms: it instantly searches their entire history of company documents, finding exactly what they need in seconds. Deal size is $20,000 setup plus $1,500/month recurring.



Two firms found me through search engines while looking for a solution to this exact problem. They reached out directly. The demand is real, the pipeline is growing, and I need one person who can pick up the phone and turn that demand signal into booked discoveries — at volume.





THE ROLE



Cold calling (primary motion): Dial
civil engineering firms per day using Apollo's parallel dialer. Get past gatekeepers. Reach Managing Principals, Directors of Engineering, and BD Directors at US firms (50-250 employees). Open with a one-line problem hook, qualify in 90 seconds, book the discovery.



Multi-touch follow-up: Layer LinkedIn DMs and Apollo
 sequences around the dials. The phone is the tip of the spear; the rest is reinforcement and re-engagement.



Full-cycle sales: Run the discovery, handle pricing and objections, close. I'll join for a 10-minute technical demo where it helps.



The honest vibe: This is a phone-first role. Realistic baseline (Cognism 2026 industry average: ~3% cold-call connect rate, 200K+ calls analyzed): 5-10 live-answer connects, 2-4 real conversations, 0-2 booked discoveries on a good day. Good weeks: 4-6 discoveries. Bad weeks: 1-2. Parallel dialing helps volume but introduces a ~2-second pickup delay you'll learn to handle. If you've never enjoyed a cold dial, this is not your role.





WHY JOIN ME



Skilled PH closers have options right now. Why this one:



- $20K deals with technically literate engineering leaders. Consultative, not scripted — AI-resilient work where a human voice is the entire moat.



- You work directly with me. No agency politics, no middle managers, no shifting comp plans.



- Performance-tied raises with a concrete milestone ladder from day one.



- Wise payments every Friday. No end-of-quarter delays.





COMPENSATION



Stage: Start

Hours: 4 hrs/day

Base: $8.50/hr ($748/mo)

Commission: 5?sh collected

Milestone Bonus: $50/qualified discovery, $100/signed contract



Stage: After deal #1

Hours: 5 hrs/day

Base: $8/hr ($880/mo)

Commission: 5?sh collected

Milestone Bonus: $400



Stage: After deal #3

Hours: 6 hrs/day

Base: $8.50/hr ($1,122/mo)

Commission: 5?sh collected

Milestone Bonus: $750



Stage: After deal #5

Hours: 8 hrs/day (full-time)

Base: $9/hr ($1,584/mo)

Commission: 5?sh collected

Milestone Bonus: $1,500



Stage: After deal #10

Hours: 8 hrs/day

Base: $10/hr ($1,760/mo)

Commission: 6?sh collected

Milestone Bonus: $2,500



Commission is 5% of cash collected on closed deals. On a $20K setup that pays $1,000 the week the customer's payment clears. Plus 5% of monthly recurring revenue for 12 months trailing, so each closed deal also pays $75-$90 per month for the next year.



Realistic monthly earnings:



- Month 1 (ramp, dialing into a cold list): $750-$950

- Month 2 (rhythm settles, 8 discoveries booked): ~$1,150

- Month 3 (first close lands): ~$2,400 in the month it lands, plus trailing

- Full-time at 2 closes per month: $4,000-$5,500



13th-month bonus: Pro-rated 13th-month bonus paid in December, calculated as one month of average earnings (base + commission) over the year worked. Standard PH practice. In addition to all other comp.





SCHEDULE



4 hours per day, Monday through Friday, on US Eastern Time business hours: 9 AM to 1 PM ET, which is 10 PM to 2 AM Manila. This window is non-negotiable — civil engineering principals pick up phones between 9 AM and 12 PM their local time, and that's the only window where the dials convert. Weekends off. Hours expand as deal milestones hit.



If you cannot work the late-night Manila shift consistently, do not apply.





WHAT I PROVIDE ON DAY 1



You won't spend week 1 waiting on me. Before you start I'll have ready:



- LinkedIn Sales Navigator with a saved list of 2,000+ qualified prospects matching the ICP

- 
 with phone numbers loaded, the parallel dialer configured, and
 sequences pre-built

- A cold-call opener, qualification script, and objection-handling cheat sheet covering the top 8 objections ("we already tried ChatGPT," "send me an
," "we use SharePoint search," "what's the price," "not interested," etc.) — each with a 15-30-second counter

- A gatekeeper-navigation script for the receptionist at firms where principals don't list direct lines

- DocuSign for sending contracts

- Recordings of past discovery calls and demos so you can learn the pitch before your first dial





WHAT YOU NEED



- 3+ years B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years cold-calling US prospects (not just appointment setting from warm or inbound lists)



- Specific cold-call track record. You can name 3 past closed deals with company, deal size ($5K minimum), and confirm at least 2 of those originated from outbound dials you personally made



- Fluent, clear, neutral-accent English. You'll be on the phone with 55-year-old principal engineers in Portland and Houston who will hang up on muddy audio or heavy accent. We'll do an unscripted Google Meet interview before any offer.



- Used a power dialer (Apollo dialer, Aircall, JustCall, Orum, PhoneBurner, or similar) and LinkedIn Sales Navigator



- Comfortable talking shop. You don't need a civil engineering background, but you do need to commit to an 8-10 week technical ramp. Weeks 1-2: product immersion (recorded discoveries, AASHTO/ACI/AWWA primer, 8-objection cheat sheet). Weeks 3-6: real discoveries with me on every call. Weeks 7-10: discoveries solo. Strong technical B2B SaaS sales experience + willingness to study civil engineering basics is the bar.



- Stable internet (25 Mbps minimum), wired connection, UPS backup for power outages, dedicated work computer (not shared), noise-canceling USB headset (Jabra, Logitech, or equivalent — not Bluetooth earbuds). If you need to upgrade, I'll reimburse $75 toward this on your first paycheck.





DON'T APPLY IF



- Your background is primarily residential real-estate cold-calling (wholesale, probate, lease-up), mortgages, or customer service. B2B real-estate-tech / proptech / SaaS sales is welcome.



- You've never personally cold-dialed and closed a $5K+ deal



- You're allergic to the phone, or you've built your career on &quot
-only" outreach



- You can't work consistent late-night Manila hours



- You require a pre-revenue guaranteed monthly minimum higher than $1,200 (expect $800-$1,150 initially, with high commission upside post-revenue)



- You prefer to work hands-off. We'll do weekly call reviews — 2 per week for the first 60 days — listening to your recorded dials together





HOW TO APPLY



Send 4 things. Incomplete applications get auto-rejected.



Open your reply with exactly this sentence: "I have personally cold-dialed US prospects and closed at least one B2B deal of $5,000 or more, and I can work 10 PM-2 AM Manila time Monday through Friday." Any application missing this exact sentence will not be reviewed.



Platform requirement: OnlineJobs.ph ID Proof score of 70 or higher, profile updated within the last 30 days.



Then send these 4 items:



1. A 60-90-second Loom video: introduce yourself, then walk me through the best cold-call-sourced B2B deal you ever closed (company, deal size, what you sold, the objection that nearly killed it, how you handled it). At the start of the video, read this paragraph aloud, word-for-word: "I'm pitching SalemWise to a civil engineering principal at a 120-person firm. Their archive holds 7 TB of AASHTO and AWWA project documents going back to the 1980s. They're skeptical of AI."



2. A real cold-call recording you made in a past role (redact the prospect's name/company if needed), OR a 90-second mock against this scenario: "You're cold-calling the Director of Engineering at a 120-person civil firm in Denver to pitch an AI document search tool. The receptionist just transferred you. He picks up — 'This is Mike.' Go." Upload to Loom or Drive.



3. List of 3 past closed deals with details. For at least one of the three, provide EITHER (a) the buyer's LinkedIn URL — I'll send them a 2-sentence
 to confirm the deal closed, OR (b) two past managers' LinkedIn URLs from that role and I'll call one. If neither path is available for any of your 3 deals, this isn't the right role.



4. Reply with subject line: Closer Application | [Your Name] | [Years cold-calling US deals] | [Earliest start date]





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



- I review complete applications within 48 hours



- Top 10-15 candidates get a 15-minute unscripted phone screen on the dialer you'll use day 1 — voice quality and live conversation check before we invest interview time



- Top 5-8 candidates get a 45-minute Google Meet interview with me



- Top 2-3 do a 30-minute live role-play: I play a skeptical 58-year-old Principal Engineer at a civil firm in Portland; you cold-call me, get past the gatekeeper, run discovery, and pitch



- Reference checks with 2 past managers or clients



- 3-week paid trial at $900 flat. KPIs: 375+ dials, 22+ real conversations, 6+ qualified discoveries booked, 3+ discoveries run with me observing



- If trial KPIs hit, long-term contract starts. If not, we end cleanly with no hard feelings





THE HONEST TRUTH ABOUT MONTH 1



You'll dial 2,200-3,300 numbers. You'll hit voi
 more than half the time. You'll get hung up on. You'll hear "we already tried ChatGPT and it didn't work" at least twice a week. (You'll have a 20-second counter for that. I'll teach you the counter.) You'll earn $800-$1,000.



You'll also book your first 4-6 discoveries and start to feel where the real conversations live in the day — usually 9:30-11:30 AM prospect time, Tuesday through Thursday.



Push through months 1 and 2 and month 3 starts paying. By month 6 you're in a completely different place. The milestone ladder above is the actual structure I'm signing up for, not a marketing pitch.



If the dialing volume in month 1 worries you, this is not your role. If you've been waiting for a real cold-call seat with real comp upside, apply.





Yermek

SalemWise Solutions

title: Remote Construction Estimator (Australian Construction Company)
description:
We are assisting an established Australian construction business in finding a reliable and detail-oriented Remote Construction Estimator to support their team with material take-offs, labour estimating, Bills of Quantities, quotation preparation, and marked-up drawings.



The company specialises in ceilings, partitions, and carpentry works across a wide range of projects, including residential homes, commercial warehouses, residential high-rise towers, and mixed-use developments with retail spaces.



This is a great opportunity for someone with strong experience in reading architectural plans, taking measurements from drawings, and preparing accurate construction estimates.



About the Role

The successful candidate will be provided with architectural drawing packages issued by developers or clients. You will be responsible for reviewing these plans carefully, identifying the materials required, completing accurate take-offs, preparing Bills of Quantities, and assisting with quotation preparation.



The company will provide Australian supplier and trade pricing, so the priority is finding someone who is confident in understanding architectural plans, performing measurements, and producing accurate quantity take-offs.



Key Responsibilities

v Review and interpret architectural drawings and construction documentation

v Carry out accurate material take-offs from architectural plans

v Prepare Bills of Quantities for ceilings, partitions, carpentry, framing, plasterboard, and related works

v Assist in preparing material and labour estimates

v Mark up drawings to show measured areas, quantities, and relevant construction details

v Organise estimate files, take-off records, and supporting documents clearly

v Work closely with the business owners or project team to clarify project requirements

v Ensure all estimates are accurate, well-presented, and completed within agreed timeframes

v Maintain awareness of material requirements and pricing information provided by the company



Essential Requirements

v Proven experience as a Construction Estimator, Quantity Surveyor, Take-Off Specialist, or similar role

v Strong ability to read and interpret architectural plans and drawings

v Experience completing construction take-offs and quantity measurements

v Good understanding of construction materials, particularly in ceilings, partitions, plasterboard, framing, or carpentry

v Strong attention to detail and accuracy

v Good numerical and analytical skills

v Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

v Strong written English communication skills

v Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely



Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following areas would be highly regarded:

v Ceilings and partitions estimating

v Carpentry estimating

v Drywall, plasterboard, framing, or fit-out works

v Residential and commercial construction projects

v Australian, UK, US, or international construction estimating

v Preparing Bills of Quantities and quotation documents

v Working with developer-issued architectural packages



Software Experience

Experience with any of the following tools would be an advantage:

v Bluebeam Revu

v PlanSwift

v Cubit

v CostX

v Buildxact

v AutoCAD

v Microsoft Excel

v Any other construction estimating or take-off software



Applicants do not need to know all of these tools, but must be comfortable working with digital drawings and completing accurate measurements.



What the Company Will Provide

v Architectural drawing packages

v Australian supplier and trade pricing

v Guidance on the company’s estimating process

v Clear instructions for each project

v Ongoing remote work opportunities for the right candidate



Work Arrangement

v Remote / Work from Home (Morning shift)

v Full-time or part-time arrangement may be considered depending on experience

v Must be available for regular communication during agreed working hours

v Long-term opportunity for the right person



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is accurate, organised, reliable, and confident in reading construction drawings. You should be able to work through an architectural package, identify the relevant scope, measure the required areas, and prepare a clear and accurate Bill of Quantities.



This role is best suited to someone who already has practical estimating or quantity surveying experience and can work independently after receiving project instructions.



How to Apply

Please send the following:

1. Your updated CV or resume

2. A short summary of your construction estimating experience

3. Details of the types of projects you have worked on

4. The estimating or take-off software you have used

5. Sample take-offs, Bills of Quantities, marked-up drawings, or estimating work, if available

6. Your expected monthly rate or hourly rate



Applicants with direct experience in architectural plan reading, take-offs, and construction estimating will be prioritised.

Brandi Hudson, a performance coach, public speaker, and founder of a growing leadership brand, is seeking a full-time COO/Chief of Staff to be her right-hand across brand development, business development, client experience, and financial operations.

You're the person who makes sure the trains run, the opportunities get closed, and Brandi can stay focused on showing up powerfully for her clients and audience.

Collaborating on brand positioning and ensuring all external touchpoints reflect Brandi's voice.



Business Development & Client Nurturing

Following up with prospective clients, partners, and warm leads fro
etings and events. Drafting personalized proposals, pitches, and follow-up sequences. Maintaining a clean CRM with every relationship, conversation, and next step documented. Building nurture systems so that no high-potential connection goes cold.



Financial Operations

Tracking business expenses and keeping books organized for the bookkeeper/accountant. Managing client billing, invoicing, and payment follow-up. Light financial reporting, including what's coming in, what's going out, and what needs attention.



Operations & Chief of Staff Support

Running point on weekly priorities across the team in Asana and Notion. Preparing Brandi for meetings with briefs, biographies, talking points, and follow up actions. Managing inbox and calendar at a strategic level, protecting time, and surfacing what matters. Building and refining SOPs so the business gets more efficient over time.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU



Are based in the Philippines and able to work PST hours. Have 3+ years in a COO, Chief of Staff, Ops Manager, or senior EA role, ideally with a founder, coach, or personal brand. Speak and write polished, engaging English and can ghostwrite in someone else's voice. Have hands on experience with client billing, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping workflows. Have run outreach or business development before and have wins you can point to. Are highly proactive, you don't wait for instructions, you anticipate and move. Are deeply organized, nothing slips through the cracks on your watch. Are confident with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and use them to multiply your output. Are excited to build alongside a mission driven founder.



TOOLS WE USE (You should be comfortable with most of these)



Google Workspace, Asana, Notion, Slack, Zoom, Canva, ChatGPT or other AI writing tools, LinkedIn, QuickBooks or similar (or willingness to learn), and a CRM (HubSpot, Notion CRM, or similar).



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE



5 to 10 aligned podcast pitches sent per week, with a healthy booking rate. 2 to 3 speaking opportunities researched and pitched per week. A clean, current CRM where every client and lead has a clear next step. Client billing sent on time, every time, and expenses tracked weekly. Brandi walks into every meeting prepped and leaves every meeting with follow ups handled. Clear, timely communication with the internal team and external partners.



We're building something powerful, a brand and business with reach, depth, and lasting impact. If you're the kind of operator who takes pride in making things run beautifully behind the scenes and loves seeing the wins your work creates, we'd love to meet you.



NEXT STEPS

Let's make big things happen, together.

title: AI Video Editor (Remote)
description:
Job Details



Are you a results-driven video editor who uses AI tools to produce high-performing eCommerce content faster and better? Join us as we build the future of men's wellness in the Philippines, starting with skincare. Our vision is to become the #1 premiu
n's wellness brand in the Philippines by 2026, and we need a talented video editor to help us achieve that goal.



As an eCommerce Video Editor, you will be responsible for bringing scripts and concepts to life through video — using both traditional editing skills and AI generation tools. Our creative strategists develop the messaging and direction; your job is to execute those ideas at a high level, making smart visual choices that maximize ad performance. Your primary focus will be producing videos that perform well in our advertising campaigns - this is the ultimate measure of success in this role.



This is a fantastic opportunity to join a performance-driven startup culture, work remotely, and contribute directly to the company's success. Video editors who excel in this role and demonstrate strategic thinking have a clear path to promotion into Creative Strategist positions.



What Sets Great Editors Apart



You'll receive scripts and creative direction from our strategists. But the best editors we've worked with don't just follow instructions mechanically — they understand why certain visual choices work better than others.



When a strategist says "make the hook punchy" or "this section needs more urgency," a great editor knows what that actually means in terms of:



- Cut timing and pacing

- Which clip to choose when you have multiple options

- When to hold on a shot vs. when to cut away

- How visual rhythm affects viewer attention

- When to use AI-generated footage vs. stock vs. UGC for maximum impact



This comes from understanding basic principles of attention and persuasion, not because you need to be a psychologist, but because it makes you a sharper, faster editor. When you understand why something works, you don't need to be told exactly what to do every time.



We don't expect you to create strategy. We expect you to execute strategy intelligently — and when we ask "why did you cut here?" or "why this clip instead of that one?", you should be able to give answers backed by real data and/or research.



Job Responsibilities



Video Strategy Development



- Create complete video advertisements by combining clips, transitions, and effects that align with the script's intent

- Produce multiple variations of video components (hooks, bodies, CTAs) to enable comprehensive testing

- Develop both new videos and iterations of existing content to optimize performance

- Generate AI voiceovers and clips to deliver scripts professionally

- Execute creative direction from strategists while making smart visual decisions within that framework

- Deliver edits and revisions within agreed timelines to support rapid testing and scaling

- Apply brand guidelines consistently across all edits and variations

- Ensure all video assets are launch-ready by meeting platform specifications (aspect ratios, length, safe zones, captions) and following established naming conventions, formats, and delivery deadlines

- Actively participate in creative strategy sessions alongside the Senior Creative Strategist and Senior DR Copywriter

- Contribute original ideas and angles for video ad concepts across all formats (UGC, influencer, customer interview, street interview, video content, etc.)

- Assist in translating strategy into production-ready briefs and executions



Content Sourcing & Management



- Source high-quality b-roll and video clips from stock providers and online platforms

- Generate custom AI video clips, b-roll, and visual assets using tools like Higgsfield, Freepik, Runway, Kling, Veo or similar — this is a core part of the role, not a nice-to-have. We provide access to Higgsfield, Freepik, Storyblocks, and Envato.

- Proactively experiment with new AI tools to find faster, higher-quality ways to produce content — we expect you to stay ahead of the curve

- Maintain an organized library of video assets for efficient access by the entire team



Performance Support



- Work closely with the marketing team to understand which videos are performing and why

- Suggest workflow improvements that increase creative throughput

- Create video variations based on strategist feedback to overcome performance challenges

- Learn to read performance data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR) and understand how your editing choices affect these metrics



Production Expectation



[1] Ad spend of your videos = your videos must be hitting our targets every month. This helps us measure the quality of the creatives performance-wise.



Every month, there will be 3-4 ad spend tiers to reach (could change depending on the business focus, strategy, and needs).



[2] Capacity contribution index = actual minutes / targeted minutes



(This too could change depending on the business focus, strategy, and needs).



Remember: The ultimate goal is creating videos that perform well in advertising. These are max capacity requirements that we expect from the role.



Volume and ad spend are directly connected. The more quality videos you produce, the more creatives we can test and scale — which directly feeds your Ad Spend KPI. Editors who consistently hit their weekly minutes give the media buying team more ammunition to find winners, which means more spend on your videos. Falling short on volume limits what we can test, which limits what we can scale, which makes hitting your spend target harder.



Ultimately, quality and effectiveness always take priority over strict adherence to these quantity guidelines — but understand that volume is the lever that makes spend possible.



20 Minutes Worth of Video Scripts Finished Weekly



This could take various forms depending on our campaign needs (e.g. new videos involving complete production from scratch or variations and iterations involving modifying specific sections of existing videos to test and optimize performance.)



- Example Scenario 1: Five 4-minute product videos showcasing different benefits

- Example Scenario 2: Four 5-minute testimonial or educational videos

- Example Scenario 3: Twenty 1-minute ads with different messaging angles

- Or any mix that totals 20 minutes of net new videos produced for the week.



How We Calculate Script Duration



We use (
) to determine how long a script is. Here's how it works:



1. Take the script text (Lead + Body only — this is the actual spoken content).

2. Paste it into 
.

3. The Read Aloud Time shown by the tool is the official duration of that script.



Examples:



1. Script: Dr Kelly 1 || Read Aloud Time = 1:06



2. Script: 121525_i001TWC-00257_MasculinityWorkWifeVID_Evergreen_TE || Read aloud Time: 3:26





So if you finished both scripts above in a week, that's 4 minutes and 32 seconds toward your weekly 20-minute target.



"Finished" is defined as a video that has been approved by the senior creative strategist or copywriter for launch as ads.



Remember: The ultimate goal is creating videos that perform well in advertising. These minutes are simply the minimum capacity requirement that we expect from the role.



Editors who consistently hit KPIs, meet the minimum capacity and quality standards, and are always on-time - for 2 months straight - may opt in to higher capacity tiers (e.g., 22 / 25 / 27 / 30 minutes worth of video scripts finished per week) to accelerate their pay progression.



Capacity tiers are optional and must be achievable within standard work hours; they do not replace KPIs as the primary measure of success.



The simplest way to think about it: Your Ad Spend KPI measures whether your videos are good enough to scale. Your weekly minutes measure whether you're producing enough for us to find and scale winners. You need both — great videos that nobody makes aren't useful, and lots of videos that don't perform aren't useful either.



Qualifications



AI Video Generation (Required): Hands-on experience with AI video generation tools (Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, or similar). You must be able to demonstrate work you've produced using these tools. This is not optional.



Experience: Minimum 3-5 years of experience in video editing and production, with specific experience in eCommerce or direct response advertising.



Results Orientation: Demonstrated ability to create videos that drive measurable business results, particularly in advertising performance.



Technical Skills: Proficiency with video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar). Understanding of video formats, resolutions, and specifications for various platforms.



Portfolio: Impressive portfolio of successful video campaigns with demonstrated performance results. Must include examples of AI-generated content.



Analytical Thinking: Competence in interpreting performance data and translating insights into effective video content strategies.



Time Management: Ability to manage multiple video projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.



Self-Directed: Motivated, well-organized, and able to work effectively in a remote setting with minimal supervision.



Bonus Skills: Experience in men's wellness/grooming industry or with premium/luxury brands is a plus but not required.





Compensation & Benefits



Salary: Competitive monthly salary (PHP 50,000 - 60,000 gross pay with twice a year increases based on Key Performance Indicators).



Bonuses: Performance-based bonuses and incentives for hitting or exceeding targets.



Benefits: Includes government-mandated benefits (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), 13th-month pay, and paid leave entitlements upon regularization.



Contract: Full-time employee status following a 6-month probationary period, with regularization based on performance review. Performance will be evaluated based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) focused primarily on advertising performance metrics.





Work Setup



Contract: This is a full-time, employment position (starting with a 6-month probationary period)



Location: This is a fully remote position.



Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM PHT (includes a 1-hour break).



Equipment: Must have a reliable internet connection and a suitable personal device (laptop) for work.





Application



If you are a talented video editor with strong AI generation skills and a focus on creating high-performing content, we encourage you to apply! Join us in our vision to become the #1 premiu
n's wellness brand in the Philippines by 2026.



Successful submissions will proceed to a paid trial task. Your strategic thinking and compelling videos will help shape the future of men's wellness in the Philippines, starting with skincare. Apply now to become a key part of our journey to transform the industry!

description:
We are MSTR, an AI software company based in the Netherlands. We build custom AI-driven applications that help businesses work smarter and more intelligently, from first conversation to production-ready product.



Our team has around 17 people: a customer-facing team of 6 here in the Netherlands, and 11 developers based in the Philippines. All of our sales currently happen in the Netherlands. We're expanding internationally, and we need someone to help us open those doors.



What this role is:

You'll be the engine behind MSTR's international growth. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: pick up the phone, have real conversations with decision-makers in the US, UK, and Europe, and book qualified meetings for our Netherlands-based sales team. They handle the closing (for now).



This is not a call center role and not a scripted pitch. You will represent a premium AI consultancy in front of CTOs, Heads of Engineering, and Product Leaders. We provide a curated lead list, full product training, and the tools you need to work efficiently.



What you'll actually be doing:

- High-volume outbound cold calling to decision-makers at target companies

- Qualifying prospects based on fit, interest, and alignment with our offerings

- Booking qualified meetings directly into the calendars of our Dutch sales team

- Supporting outreach through LinkedIn engagement and messaging

- Assisting our Head of Sales with outreach materials and lead research

- Reporting weekly on activity, pipeline, and insights from conversations



What you'll be selling:

- Work-with-AI program (3 to 5 weeks): we identify AI opportunities inside a company, deliver a prioritized roadmap and start building these out in an AI Operating System we set up for the client. 

- Deep Dive (3 to 5 weeks): the full technical blueprint of an AI solution, ready for development.

- AI Development training (3 to 5 weeks): hands-on training for development teams of 5 to 100 developers on how to build with AI.



Average deal size is €10,000 to €20,000. Target companies sit between 20 and 500 employees in sectors like construction, real estate, software/SaaS, finance/legal, and HR/payroll.



Who we're looking for:

title: Chase Points / Airline Miles Flight Researcher / Travel planner
description:
I am looking for someone with real experience researching flights using credit card points and airline miles.



This is for a family trip to Asia. I have Chase Sapphire Reserve points and need help finding the best way to use points for the main international flights. 



Trip Details



Family of 4.



Outbound:

Denver to Bangkok

Preferred departure around July 20–23



Return:

Hong Kong to Denver

About 3 weeks later

Flexible to add a few days to the 3 weeks if it saves points or money



I am okay with economy, but I also want to compare premium economy or business class if the points difference is reasonable.



I have seen possible routes through Air Canada / Vancouver to Bangkok, so I would like someone who can check options like that and other good routing ideas.



What I Need Help With



I need someone to research:



Best Chase transfer partner options

Award flight availability for 4 people

Economy vs premium economy vs business class value

Possible routes from Denver or nearby gateway cities like Vancouver, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, etc.

Taxes and fees

Exact booking steps

Risks before transferring points



You will not have access to my Chase account or personal logins. You are only doing research. I will handle the actual booking myself.



I understand that point transfers are usually final, so I need someone who knows how to search carefully before I move any points.



Paid Project



I will first choose the strongest applicant for a small paid test.



The first paid task will be $20 for a limited research sample so I can confirm your process and accuracy.



If the work is good, I will pay $100–$150 for the full flight research project, including:



Denver to Bangkok

Hong Kong to Denver

Best Chase transfer options

Points needed for 4 people

Taxes and fees

Economy / premium economy / business comparison

Exact booking steps



I may also pay a bonus if I book one of your options and it saves significant points or money.



To Apply

give me your background and let me know how you would search these flight options for 4 people from Denver to Bangkok in late July using Chase points. Explain the first 3 places you would search, which Chase transfer partners you would check first. Explain some of your previous great deals you have found.

What tools or websites do you use to search award flights?

This isn't a beginner gig.



We're a fast-moving DTC female health/wellness brand running paid ads on Meta and we need AI video editors who can take a script and turn it out into a fully produced, scroll-stopping ad — end to end — with zero hand-holding. We are a womens probioti dtc brand. If you have similar experience that is a benefit. 



If you've built AI UGC videos that have actually spent real money at scale, we want to talk. If you're still figuring out the tools, this isn't the right fit.



You'll receive scripts and creative briefs. Your job is to produce complete, publish-ready video ads including:

- AI UGC / Talking Head Ads: Realistic AI avatars that feel indistinguishable from real creators — correct lip sync, natural movement, authentic delivery. Think product hold, eye contact, conversational tone. These need to feel like organic TikTok content, not obviously generated.



- AI Visual Essay / Mechanism Ads: Full AI-produced videos with no human presenter — opening with a visceral or curiosity-driven hook visual, transitioning into 3D anatomical or product mechanism animations, supported by cinematic B-roll, all with dynamic animated captions synced to voiceover. Think science-documentary meets direct response.



- Hybrid Formats: AI avatar with B-roll cutaways, green screen compositing, product close-ups, hook cards, and branded end screens combined in a single cohesive video.



Video Specs:

Length: 60 seconds to 5 minutes depending on creative angle

Format: Vertical 9:16 (primary), square 1:1, horizontal 16:9 as needed

Platform: Meta 
 + Instagram Reels/Feed)

Deliverable: Final cut with captions burned in, ready to upload





If you can produce at this level across both formats, we want to hear from you.



Technical Skills Required:

- AI avatar generation: HeyGen, Synthesia, D-ID, or equivalent — photorealistic output only

- AI image/video generation: Runway, Kling, Sora, MidJourney, or equivalent for B-roll and visual essay assets

- 3D / medical animation: Ability to produce or source and edit anatomical/product mechanism animations

- Compositing: Green screen integration, realistic background replacement

- Caption design: Animated, styled subtitles (karaoke-style, word-by-word highlight, caption cards) — NOT basic auto-captions

- Editing suite: CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent

- Voiceover: AI voice selection and integration (ElevenLabs, Play.ht, or equivalent)

- Hook card design: Branded, eye-catching text overlay cards synced to the first 3 seconds



You're the right fit if you:



Have produced AI video ads that have run on Meta (not just personal projects or spec work)

Can move fast — our typical turnaround expectation is 48–72 hours per video

Understand direct response creative principles — you think about hooks, pattern interrupts, and CTAs, not just aesthetics

Are fluent in the AI toolchain and stay current as the tools evolve

Communicate clearly and flag issues early — we scale what works fast and kill what doesn't





To apply, send us:

- 2–3 examples of AI-generated video ads or AI UGC content you've produced (direct links or file uploads — no demo reels, actual ads only)

- A brief note (3–5 sentences max) on which AI tools you use for avatar generation, visual essays, and caption styling

- Your rate per video and typical turnaround time



Applications without portfolio examples will not be reviewed.



We're building something real and we move fast. If your work is at the level we're looking for, expect a paid test project within a week of applying. There will be bonuses for hitting certain ROAS goals

title: Job Title: Presentation Designer — AI Sponsor Pack (Urgent / Short-Term Contract)
description:
Overview

We are seeking a designer to work with us on refining an AI Sponsor Pack. This is a priority piece with a tight turnaround, so we need someone strong in conceptual, strategic design — not just formatting.



Objective

Translate a complex, text-heavy deck into a clear, visually-led narrative that:



Lands quickly with corporate sponsors

Makes abstract concepts tangible and compelling

Elevates the overall polish and credibility of the work



This is not a redesign from scratch — it's about refining and reinterpreting key slides.



Scope of Work

Focus on Slides 2–16 of the current master pack. Key tasks:



Simplify dense content into clear visual hierarchies

Translate complex ideas into conceptual diagrams and frameworks

Introduce strong visual storytelling (not decorative design)

Create consistency in layout, flow, and visual language

Improve readability and sponsor appeal



Design Direction

We need someone who can:



Think strategically (not just execute)

Translate complexity into simple, powerful visuals

Work with abstract/system-level concepts (AI, leadership, ethics)

Balance credibility, sophistication, and clarity



Style reference:



Clean, minimal, high-end

Conceptual (e.g. systems maps, frameworks, flows)

Confident use of space and hierarchy

Aligned with Menzies brand





Key Content to Bring to Life

The designer will need to help translate concepts such as:



"Symbiotic leadership" (human + AI systems)

"AI Ethical Advisor" (product concept)

"Universal basic infrastructure" (north star — currently abstract)

System-level ecosystem / network thinking



These are currently too text-heavy and need visual articulation.



Outputs



Refined slides (2–16) in Canva

Visual frameworks/diagrams embedded within slides

Consistent visual system that can be applied across future decks



Timing



Start: ASAP (ideally within 24–48 hours)



What We Are Looking For

Please apply only if you:



Have experience with strategy decks / consulting-style presentations

Can show examples of conceptual visualisation (not just branding)

Are comfortable working quickly and collaboratively



Materials Provided



Master deck (Canva)

Strategic input and direction from our team

title: Client Onboarding & Operations Specialist / GHL + Facebook Ads (Long-Term Role, Fast Growth Path)
description:
Client Onboarding & Operations Specialist / GHL +
 Ads (Long-Term Role, Fast Growth Path)



Salary: $1,500 to $3,000/month + performance bonuses

Hours: Part-time to start (10 to 15 hrs/week), accelerating fast for the right person

Start: ASAP



Looking to hire ASAP. Please only apply if you're the person I'm talking about when it comes to 
 and
 Ads. You should be able to knock this out on day one.



---



About Us



We're Bookd Media, a growth partner agency working with serious, high-scale remodelers in the US. We operate on a pay-per-result model, our clients are top-tier operators, and our standards are high. Our systems are dialed, our SOPs are detailed, and we move fast.

---



The Role (Where You Start)



You'll be the execution arm of the agency. Every time we sign a new client, you take it from there:



- Create the client's Go High Level account and build out their full system following our SOP

- Set up their
 Ads campaigns (Ads Manager, pixel, audiences, creatives) exactly how we want it, using our SOPs and video walkthroughs

- Build out their funnel inside GHL, plug in their info, and get them live

- Follow Claude prompts and have a minor understanding of vibe coding to help put funnels together

- Analyze ad performance daily and flag what's working, what's not, and what needs to be adjusted

- Run comprehensive strategy and data analysis on every campaign, with real meta skills, copywriting instincts, and overall experience to back it up

- Speak directly with the agency owner (me) on a regular basis with clean, comprehensive updates on every client (status, blockers, ad performance, what's next)

- Handle technical issues clients run into inside GHL so I don't have to touch them

- Be ready to jump on problems I send your way and solve them fast



The starting work is structured. The SOPs are built. You're executing the system and getting clients onboarded cleanly. That's the foundation.



Only apply if, after reading the onboarding work above, you're thinking: "Yeah, I could do this easily. This comes natural to me. I've done this in the past with
 Ads and Go High Level, and I can knock out a full client onboarding in under an hour, no problem."



If that's not you, please don't apply. I need someone who already lives in these tools, not someone who's going to learn on the job.



---



Where This Role Goes (The Real Opportunity)



This is not a click-and-go job long-term. For the right person, this becomes the operations lead seat at Bookd Media. That means building and refining SOPs yourself as we grow, hiring and managing other tea
mbers under you, real ownership over how the agency runs operationally, and a long-term role with real freedom and real growth in pay and responsibility.



I want a true killer. Someone who can follow a system to the letter today and build systems from scratch tomorrow. If you crush this, the long-term vision here is massive.



---



What You Need to Have



- Deep, hands-on experience inside Go High Level. Not surface level. You've built funnels, automations, pipelines, calendars, and workflows from scratch. You can troubleshoot when something breaks. Be ready to prove it.

- Comprehensive
 Ads experience. You know your way around Ads Manager. You've set up campaigns, pixels, audiences, and creatives. You understand CBO, testing, learning phase, ad performance metrics, and what makes an ad set work.

- Strong strategy and data analysis skills. You can look at a campaign and know what to do next.

- Solid copywriting instincts for ads and funnels.

- Comfortable following Claude prompts and a basic grasp of vibe coding to assemble funnels.

- Strong written and spoken English. You'll be communicating with me daily and occasionally with US-based clients.

- A builder's mindset. You don't just follow instructions, you find ways to make things better.

- Reliability. I need someone I can hand things off to and trust it gets done right.



---



Nice to Have



- Experience working with US-based agency clients

- Experience hiring or managing other contractors



---



How to Apply



Send a 60 to 90 second voice note covering:



- Your name

- Your experience with Go High Level (be specific, what have you built?)

- Your experience with
 Ads (what kind of campaigns have you run?)

- Why you're the very best fit for this role



No voice note, no consideration. This is non-negotiable.



Bonus points: include a short Loom (5 min max) walking through a 
 build or
 campaign you've actually set up. This will move you to the front of the line.



Looking to hire this week. Let's go.

Timecards

LCPtracker

DIR eCPR System

PRISM

Underpayments

Weekly CPR packages

5. Internal Coordination

Collaborate with internal tea
mbers on:

Compliance issues

Agency audits

Internal reviews

etings via video call

We're looking for a detail-oriented content migration specialist to support a major rebuild project for a major Australian membership organisation. This is a focused 6-week engagement during the migration window of our project — clear scope, clear targets, real production work. - Format and clean content within the CMS — fix headings, link structures, image placement, and embedded media.

- Re-link images and re-create asset references where source URLs change in the new structure.

- Support redirect mapping by flagging URL changes to the SEO lead.

- Run editorial QA against the original source pages and log any content gaps or rewrite needs.

- Track migration progress in ClickUp against an agreed daily throughput target.

- Pair with the website QA team to fix content-related issues found during testing.



Must have:

- Minimum 2 years professional content migration or content production experience.

- Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise CMS (Umbraco, Sitecore, Drupal, WordPress, Squiz, AEM, Kentico, or similar).

- Strong attention to detail; comfortable with high-volume, repetitive production work and consistent daily throughput targets.

- Strong written English; able to spot formatting, copy, and metadata issues during migration.

- Comfortable working in a structured ticketing workflow (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar).

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional remote work setup.

- Based in the Philippines with the right to work as a freelancer 



Nice to have:

- Direct Umbraco experience.

- Experience with Squiz Matrix as a source CMS.

- Familiarity with Screaming Frog crawl outputs and URL mapping.

- Experience working on multi-site or multi-tenant content architectures.

- Familiarity with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards (alt text, heading hierarchy, link descriptions).

title: Customer Support & Collections Agent
description:
If you have experience in customer support — particularly handling payments, arrears, complaints, or sensitive financial situations for UK-based companies — and you’re ready to grow into a collections role at a fast-moving fintech startup, this role is for you.



Apply here: 



About Us

We are a fast-growing fintech team delivering flexible payment solutions, including Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services, that help customers manage their everyday payments with ease. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and a customer-first mindset. If you’re looking for a role where your work genuinely matters and your growth is part of the plan, you’ve found it.



What You’ll Do

As a Collections & Customer Operations Agent, you’ll be the go-to person for our customers — helping them with payments, resolving account issues, and keeping things on track. AI drives a large part of how we work, but your judgment is what makes it effective. You’ll be responsible for feeding it the right context, reviewing outputs before they reach customers, and stepping in when something needs a human call. We move fast and hold each other to a high standard, so you’ll be expected to bring your best every day, take feedback in stride, and keep moving forward.



IMPORTANT: Please carefully read the responsibilities below to ensure you’re a good fit, and follow the instructions on how to apply at the bottom.



Big Plus — UK Customer Support Experience: If you’ve worked for a UK-based company supporting customers through payments, arrears, complaints, financial hardship, escalations, or sensitive account issues — even if your title wasn’t “collections” — this is exactly the experience we’re looking for.



Compensation:

* Competitive salary: $1,300 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)

* Opportunity to grow into a senior or team lead position as the support team expands



Benefits:

* 100% Remote — work from anywhere in the Philippines

* 15 days paid leave

* Semi-monthly salary payouts

* Paid time off and Philippine public holidays

* Supportive, startup-style culture where your ideas matter

* Clear growth path and strong learning opportunities in fintech



Working Hours:

* Shift during onboarding: 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM UK time, Monday to Friday. After onboarding, a fixed schedule will be provided depending on business needs.

* Must be willing to work during weekends

* This is a full-time role only (40 hours per week)



Core Responsibilities

* Deliver exceptional multi-channel support (chat,
, and phone) with a focus on first-contact resolution and high customer satisfaction.

* Uphold brand standards by communicating clearly, consistently, and professionally in all interactions.

* Actively manage brand reputation by professionally responding to all customer reviews and public feedback.

* Handle and resolve customer complaints with empathy and efficiency, knowing when and how to appropriately escalate complex issues.

* Oversee customer repayments and collections by assisting with payment management, rescheduling, and account oversight with professionalism and care.

* Protect the business by proactively identifying, investigating, and escalating suspicious activity and potential fraud cases.

* Work extensively with AI-driven tools as a core part of your daily workflow. This is a very AI-forward role, so genuine comfort and curiosity with AI is a must.

* Build a real understanding of our processes — not just rely on AI outputs. Speed matters, but so does knowing the reasoning behind what you’re doing.



You’re Perfect for This Role If You

* Have experience in customer support, ideally with a UK-based company, handling payments, arrears, complaints, financial hardship, escalations, or sensitive customer situations — even if your job title wasn’t specifically “collections.”

* Are familiar with collections, repayments, and debt management concepts, and can balance speed with accuracy and empathy under pressure.

* Welcome honest, direct feedback and see it as a tool for getting better, not something to take personally.

* Hold yourself to a high standard of integrity. This role gives you immediate access to sensitive financial data, and trust is non-negotiable.

* Are proficient with AI tools and a quick learner when it comes to automation and new technology.

* Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-first startup environment where priorities shift quickly.

* Are an empathetic problem solver with strong attention to detail, professionalism, and integrity.



Nice to Have:

* Direct experience in a collections, BNPL, or lending role (any market).

* Prior experience supporting UK customers in financial services, utilities, or telecoms.

* Familiarity with UK consumer financial regulations or guidelines around vulnerable customers and arrears handling.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

 Page:

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

s or

Job Type: [Full-Time / Part-Time]

We run a popular automotive YouTube and Instagram page for automotive enthusiasts, and have scaled to growing the pages to cater to clients and customers that demand the highest quality parts, with the utmost attention to service and details. Strong communication with our business clients is what separates us from our competition. We are looking to continue growing this business through our upcoming Social Media Manager role and professional video editor to enhance our marketing efforts through engaging content.



The Role

We are seeking a high-energy, multi-talented Video Editor & Social Media Manager with a deep passion for the automotive world. In this role, you will be the creator behind our digital presence. You will take raw footage of incredible builds, drives, or automotive content and turn it into videos that resonate with our current audience while reaching new viewers and customers. Beyond the edit bay, you will manage our community, engage with car enthusiasts, coordinate with high-profile guests/clients, and drive business growth.



The Horizon: We are looking for a true partner. If you are eager to learn, adaptable, and hungry for growth, this role will expand. You will have the unique opportunity to step up and manage the content and social strategies for our other diverse business entities as we scale.



Key Responsibilities

Automotive Video Production: Edit engaging long-form (YouTube) and short-form (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) content. Creating videos with immersive sound design and imagery, pacing, and visual energy is key. Color grading knowledge for videos.

Photo & Asset Editing: Use Lightroom to color-grade and retouch automotive photography for thumbnails, social posts, and marketing materials.



Social Media Management: Own the content calendar across all platforms. Stay ahead of automotive trends, trending audio, and algorithm shifts to maximize engagement and improve reach.



Client & Guest Relations: Act as the face of our brand in the digital space. Manage DMs, engage authentically with the car community, and coordinate communications with customers, influencers, and industry guests.



Cross-Industry Growth: Be ready to pivot your creative skills to analyze, adapt, and build content strategies for our other business sectors as you grow with the company.



Qualifications & Skills

Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve) and Adobe Lightroom is mandatory.

Automotive Passion: You understand car culture. You know what captures the attention of enthusiasts, and how to make a vehicle look its absolute best on camera during editing and enhancement.



Elite Communication: Exceptional written skills. You can chat casually with car enthusiasts in the comments, but switch to a professional, business-minded tone when dealing with clients and guests.



The Growth Mindset: You aren't just looking to "clock in and clock out." You are ambitious, eager to learn new industries, and want to build a long-term career with us across our other lines of business.



Self-Driven: This is a 100% remote role. You must be hyper-organized, reliable, and capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines.



What We Offer

100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a strong internet connection.



Career: Opportunity to expand your portfolio and responsibilities into other business fields under our umbrella based on your performance.



Creative Freedom: Direct input into content strategy, storytelling, and brand voice.



Compensation: To be discussed based on experience, availability, working hours, with room for growth as you take on more business entities.



How to Apply

If you love content creation in the automotive space, and want to grow alongside a expanding business ecosystem, this role may be a good fit. Please include with your resume and message the following:

- A link to your portfolio/showreel featuring your best video edits and photo work (Automotive examples are a preferred, but send your work displaying your creative talent).

- A link to your profile and your resume.

- Tell us about your favorite car or a recent automotive content trend that caught your eye.



We look forward to hearing from you.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

description:
Healthcare Data Analyst — Remote, Full-Time, 8:00am–5:00pm EST



West Orange Nephrology is a physician-owned kidney care clinic located in Winter Garden, Florida. We provide comprehensive nephrology services including chronic kidney disease management, dialysis, diagnostics, and laboratory services. We are growing rapidly and are looking for a skilled Healthcare Data Analyst to join our remote team and help us turn our practice data into clear, actionable insights. Prior experience working with US-based medical or healthcare data is required.



About the role

You will be responsible for transforming raw practice data into clean, visual dashboards and reports that help our physicians and managers make better decisions. This is not just a numbers role — we need someone who can take complex data and present it in a way that is simple, clear, and immediately useful to non-technical people. If you are an Excel or Power BI expert with a healthcare background and a sharp eye for detail, this role was made for you.



What you'll be doing

You will build and maintain interactive dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or Tableau to track key metrics including patient volume, revenue, billing performance, and wait times. You will extract and clean data from our EHR and billing systems while ensuring full HIPAA compliance at all times. You will analyze trends across our operations to identify bottlenecks, billing errors, and provider efficiency opportunities. You will translate complex data and metrics into straightforward reports and summaries that physicians and managers can understand and act on quickly. You will support ongoing reporting needs across the practice and flag anything that requires leadership attention.



Who we're looking for

We need someone with proven experience as a data analyst, preferably in a US healthcare or medical office setting. You must have advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, VLOOKUPs, formulas, and charting. Experience with Power BI or Tableau is required. You should have a strong understanding of healthcare data including EHR systems, billing data, and medical operations. The ability to work independently, manage multiple reporting tasks at once, and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders is essential. HIPAA awareness and experience handling protected health information are required.



Important

This position supports a US-based medical practice. US healthcare data or medical office experience is required. Candidates without a healthcare or medical background will not be considered.



How to apply

Send a short introduction about yourself and your data analytics background. Please answer this question: "Describe a dashboard or report you built for a healthcare or medical client. What data did it track, who used it, and what decision or improvement did it lead to?" Applications that skip this question will not be reviewed.

title: Video Editor - YouTube Channel (Long-Form + Shorts), Full-Time Long-Term
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are hiring a skilled Video Editor as the long-term editing partner for a YouTube channel in the entrepreneurship and e-commerce space (Amazon FBA, private-label sellers, building an online software product).



YouTube is the primary focus. We are publishing 2 long-form videos per week (10-14 minutes each) plus daily short-form clips (Reels, Shorts, TikToks) repurposed from the long-form content. This is consistent, ongoing work - we are building a serious educational brand and the editor we hire will be the one we build with for the long haul.



There is also some catch-up work on an existing online course hosted on Skool - clean-up edits on already-recorded lessons. That work runs in parallel for the first few weeks but it is not the main role. YouTube is where most of your hours will go.



We need a professional editor who understands pacing, clarity, and clean educational content - not flashy gaming-style edits.





WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON



Primary work (ongoing - about 80% of hours):

- 2 long-form YouTube videos per week, each 10-14 minutes

- 5 to 8 short-form clips repurposed from each long-form (Reels, Shorts, TikToks)

- Talking-head footage plus screen recordings of our software dashboards

- Light motion graphics, lower thirds, intro lower-third, end card with channel CTA

- Captions (open captions for shorts, optional for long-form)

- Light B-roll - used sparingly and purposefully

- Light color correction and audio cleanup



Secondary work (first few weeks, then tapers):

- Editing structured online course videos for our existing Skool course

- Cleaning up long-form recordings, removing filler, exporting clean



Possible later additions (optional, more pay):

- Thumbnail design or coordination

- Ad creative edits from existing YouTube footage





EDITING STYLE REFERENCE



Think clean, educational, and professional - closer to creators like Ali Abdaal, Codie Sanchez, or other long-form business/educational YouTubers. NOT MrBeast-style hyper-cuts, NOT gaming-style edits, NOT 
/entertainment pacing.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have experience editing with professional software, such as:

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- DaVinci Resolve

- Final Cut Pro

- CapCut (Pro level - for short-form)



You must:

- Have edited long-form YouTube content for business or educational creators before

- Understand pacing for educational content

- Know how to repurpose long-form into short-form (vertical crops, hooks in first 1.5s)

- Be comfortable with lower thirds, transitions, clean cuts

- Be comfortable with basic color correction and audio cleanup

- Be able to follow revision feedback carefully - we send Loom video feedback, not long text





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You only edit gaming, 
, or short-form-only content

- You rely only on templates

- You cannot handle revisions professionally

- You disappear or communicate inconsistently

- You are juggling many freelance clients



We are looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, and professional. This is a long-term hire, not a one-off project.





AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENTS



- Must be available consistently and full-time

- Must respond to messages within 24 hours

- Must hit a 48-hour turnaround from footage delivery to first long-form cut

- Must be comfortable with revision cycles

- Must be able to handle structured weekly deadlines





PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS (VERY IMPORTANT)



You must provide:

- A portfolio link

- At least 2 examples of YouTube long-form videos you've edited for educational or business creators

- Short-form (Reels / Shorts / TikTok) examples are a strong bonus

- Online course or training content examples are also a bonus



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.





WORK SCHEDULE



- Full-time preferred

- 30 to 40 hours per week

- Flexible hours within the week, but consistent communication required

- Weekly delivery rhythm: long-form #1 + its shorts by mid-week, long-form #2 + its shorts by end of week





PAY RANGE (PH MARKET)



- PHP 60,000 to 72,000 per month (USD $7/hr equivalent at full-time)

- Based on experience and skill level

- Performance-based increases available

- Paid trial: one short edit at agreed rate before ongoing offer





APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Put "Hey Dave, your educational video editor is here!" in your application subject line so we know you read everything.



Please answer the following:

1. What software do you primarily use and how long have you used it?

2. Have you edited long-form YouTube videos for a business or educational creator before? If yes, link the channel.

3. How do you approach editing educational YouTube content differently from entertainment or vlog content?

4. Have you done short-form repurposing (turning long-form into Reels/Shorts/TikToks)? How do you choose 
nts?

5. Provide 2 to 4 portfolio links - long-form preferred, short-form a bonus.

6. Are you available full-time on a consistent weekly schedule?



Reply through OnlineJobs.ph - we'll respond to shortlisted applicants within 3 business days.

Position Overview



As a Virtual Assistant, your primary responsibility will be managing rental clients by reviewing lead activity daily, organizing follow ups, and preparing curated home options based on each client's qualifications, timeline, and preferences.



You will work inside a structured workflow system designed to prioritize clients based on urgency, responsiveness, and readiness to move.

You will be expected to maintain organization across all clients and ensure every lead receives consistent attention and updates.

Properties selected should closely match the client’s requested location, budget, and lifestyle preferences. If adjustments are made to pricing or location, clear reasoning must be provided.



You will also be expected to identify strong opportunities such as motivated landlords or listings that have remained on the market longer than average.

Preferred Qualifications
