title: Customer Service VA
description:
Customer Service VA (Events Industry)



We are a fast-growing events company seeking a reliable and enthusiasticCustomer Service VA to join our team full-time.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with people, is confident on the phone, and thrives in a structured, target-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct outbound calls to invite clients to upcoming events



Introduce event details in a clear, engaging, and professional manner



Collect and update accurate customer contact information



Complete event registration forms on behalf of clients

Perform follow-up calls to confirm attendance and answer questions



Maintain accurate call logs and update Excel spreadsheets daily



Ideal Candidate



Previous experience in customer service, telemarketing, or outbound calling



Clear, friendly, and confident speaking voice



Strong English communication skills (verbal and written)



Comfortable handling objections and working toward daily call targets



Organized and detail-oriented



Positive attitude and strong work ethic



Able to meet deadlines and follow processes consistently



Remote Work Requirements (Mandatory)



Stable high-speed internet connection



Noise-cancelling headset with clear audio quality



Quiet, professional home workspace (no background noise)



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



Working Hours



Monday to Friday

7:00 AM – 4:00 PM (GMT+8)

Full-time remote position



What We Offer



Stable, long-term remote role



Supportive and growing team environment



Opportunity to grow with a fast-expanding events company



If you are confident on the phone, reliable, and ready to work in a structured remote environment, we would love to hear from you

title: Virtual Insurance Sales Team Trainer (Remote | U.S. Life Insurance Sales Experience Required)
description:
About the Role



We are seeking an experienced Virtual Insurance Sales Team Trainer to help develop and coach life insurance agents in a fast-growing, digitally driven insurance organization.



This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in U.S. life insurance sales, particularly telesales, final expense, mortgage protection, and retirement planning. You will work directly with agents to improve their phone skills, objection handling, underwriting awareness, and closing ability.



Your mission is simple: Help agents become more confident, more consistent, and more productive.



Responsibilities

Conduct live Zoom training sessions for insurance agents

Role-play sales conversations and objection handling

Review recorded calls and provide coaching feedback



Train agents on:

Bond & Rapport

Pain-Finding

Underwriting Pre-Qualification

Product Presentation

Closing



Help agents improve:

Call control

Transition statements

Handling objections

Confidence on the phone

Develop training outlines, scripts, and quick-reference materials

Support new agents during onboarding and early production



Topics You Must Be Comfortable Teaching

Final Expense(required)

Live Transfers(required)

CallTools (required, willing to train)

Lead Follow-Up(experience is a plus)

Mortgage Protection(willing to train)

Indexed Universal Life (IUL)(willing to train)

Fixed Annuities(willing to train)

CRM systems (GoHighLevel experience is a plus)



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of U.S. life insurance sales experience

Proven experience training or coaching sales agents

Strong understanding of telesales and phone-based selling

Excellent spoken English

Comfortable leading live Zoom sessions

Ability to break down complex sales concepts simply

High level of professionalism and reliability



 Preferred Qualifications

Experience with NEPQ or consultative sales methodologies

Familiarity with final expense underwriting

Knowledge of multiple insurance carriers and products

Experience reviewing call recordings

Leadership or agency-building experience



Key Traits We’re Looking For

Strong communicator

Patient teacher

Results-oriented

Organized

Encouraging but accountable

High energy and positive attitude



What Success Looks Like: Within your first 90 days, you will help agents:

Increase confidence on the phone

Improve objection handling

Shorten sales cycles

Raise close rates

Get into production faster



To Apply: Please send:

Your resume

A short video introducing yourself

A summary of your insurance sales and training experience

Any examples of training materials you’ve created

Your hourly rate



Why Join Us? Become part of our family and NOT hired help!



You’ll work with a mission-driven organization focused on helping families protect what matters most while helping agents build meaningful, high-income careers.



We provide a modern, digitally supported platform with strong leadership, proven systems, and a culture centered on growth and service.



Application Question: Answer required please



What is your favorite sales objection to teach agents how to overcome, and why?

title: Marketing Admin & Operations Coordinator
description:
We're looking for a reliable and proactive marketing admin who can help manage day-to-day marketing tasks and keep our projects running smoothly. This is a combination role where you'll handle marketing execution AND help coordinate our workflow and contractors.



Marketing Responsibilities:



Design execution in Canva (taking existing templates/concepts and building out additional content)

Social media scheduling using Buffer (uploading content, ensuring correct tags, timing, and formatting)

Basic copywriting/editing - proofreading content for grammar, spelling, and factual accuracy (you won't be writing from scratch, but ensuring everything reads well and information is correct)

Data collection and reporting (gathering metrics for marketing performance)

Content uploading to WordPress (copy/paste articles, basic formatting, image insertion)

General marketing administrative tasks



Operations/Project Management Responsibilities:



Daily check-in calls on working days to review priorities and workflow

Track project status and deadlines

Help manage and coordinate with other contractors

Keep tasks organized and flag anything that needs attention

Needs to know or be eager to learn how to use Notion



Requirements:



Intermediate/expert level - you will likely need to learn a few things, but we need someone who understands how to deliver at a high-level

Strong English communication, both written and verbal (you'll be editing content and we'll be talking daily)

Excellent attention to detail (critical for editing and fact-checking)

Basic familiarity with Canva, Buffer, and WordPress (or eager and able to learn quickly)

Highly organized and proactive

Reliable internet connection and workspace



Available for 20 hours/3 days with flexible scheduling on those days

Available for daily calls on working days - I am located in Australia, AEDT
